comparison.objective: Reverse a conveyor motor by swapping two phase leads; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Lead unplugging, reassignment, and socket insertion versus hex-key alignment, counterholding, collar adjustment, relocking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: All three leads home in an odd permutation and tote passes the forward line versus two safe non-bottoming stops with bounded drift. No separate spec versions were provided.
comparison.reason: Connector reassignment and phase-order validation do not test damping adjustment.
